firmware.name: OTA base
firmware.description: Wi-Fi hotspot (ESP32-OTA-XXXX, password esp32ota) with the update page at 192.168.4.1, plus Ethernet and optional home Wi-Fi. Flash once; update wirelessly after that.

firmware.name: Camera viewer
firmware.description: Live camera feed on the hotspot's sign-in page, with the same update page at /update.

firmware.name: Camera + stepper bench
firmware.description: Camera tab plus an A4988 stepper tab: 20-1000 rpm, acceleration limit, microstepping off / 1/4 / auto. STEP on IO3 or IO17, MS2 on IO16.
